latest.title: A Counterexample to Yau's Conjectured Asymptotic Scalar-Curvature Integral Bound
latest.abstract: A complete one-ended three-manifold with strictly positive Ricci curvature is constructed such that $$ \limsup_{R\to\infty}\frac1R\int_{B(p,R)} Scal\,dV=+\infty. $$ The construction combines an explicit toric lens carrying a large scalar-curvature integral with a three-dimensional angular pair of pants and an adaptive sequence of hybrid blocks.
latest.workSummary: 作者声称构造严格正 Ricci 曲率单端三维完备流形，其标量曲率球积分除以半径的上极限无穷大。
latest.breakthrough: 针对 Yau 渐近标量曲率积分界给出反例方案。
latest.limitations: 重点核查拼接后的严格 Ricci 正性、完备性和积分估计；AI 生成不代替证明审查。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者评论及 AI usage 段披露 ChatGPT 生成主要定理和证明，作者参与构造方向的选择。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06533v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
latest.priorityReason: 直接涉及非负 Ricci 大尺度几何与核心猜想。
